public_url.name: Fixed HTTPS address for this Nocturne
public_url.description: Use the certificate hostname and configured host port, not an IP address or /setup path. Do not casually change the hostname after registering passkeys.

certificate.name: Certificate filename
certificate.description: Filename in /ssl, for example fullchain.pem. Also specify the private key. Both empty creates only a temporary startup-test certificate.

private_key.name: Private key filename
private_key.description: Filename in /ssl, for example privkey.pem. Never paste key contents here. It must match the certificate.

gateway_auth.name: Extra username/password popup
gateway_auth.description: On: extra popup with username nocturne and the code from the HA status page. Off: Nocturne controls access; configured trusted TLS remains required. The wrapper checks private authentication unless you explicitly skip that check. Save and restart this app.

skip_gateway_check.name: Consciously skip gateway check
skip_gateway_check.description: Default off. Only effective with gateway_auth off. Skips only the wrapper authentication check; Nocturne access/share permissions still decide who can read or write. TLS and hostname checks remain active. Does not enable anonymous access itself. Save and restart this app.

maintenance_enabled.name: Enable experimental maintenance
maintenance_enabled.description: Personal only: CLI, recovery wizard and root terminal inside this app through HA. Off by default. Separate password required. Back up first; save and restart.

maintenance_password.name: Separate maintenance password
maintenance_password.description: Unique password of 16–256 characters. Username: maintenance. Not displayed on the status page. Required only when maintenance is enabled.

network.8448/tcp: Nocturne HTTPS: host port must match the fixed HTTPS address. Router port forwarding is not needed.
